sheets.title: Conceptual Lot Layout
sheets.note: Illustrative street and lot arrangement for approximately 300 homesites, with waterfront, lake-view and interior lots around preserved open space.

sheets.title: Boundary Survey
sheets.note: Signed boundary survey of the property, dated March 10, 2003. Prepared for Sadler Farms LLC by Barge Waggoner Sumner & Cannon (BWSC); Sec. 20, T3S, R6W, Limestone County, Alabama. Original scale 1" = 200'.

sheets.title: Boundary Survey with Topography
sheets.note: The same survey with topographic contours, revised March 18, 2003. Prepared for Sadler Farms LLC by Barge Waggoner Sumner & Cannon (BWSC); Sec. 20, T3S, R6W, Limestone County, Alabama. Original scale 1" = 200'.

facts.label: Location
facts.value: Davis Road & Snake Road, Limestone County, Alabama

facts.label: Waterfront
facts.value: More than one mile along the Tennessee River's Wheeler Reservoir, east of the Elk River confluence; portions are direct waterfront and portions are continuous to vertical TVA bluff land

facts.label: Coves
facts.value: Two protected coves; one is suitable for possible marina development

facts.label: Drive times
facts.value: About 15 minutes to Athens and 25 minutes to Huntsville

facts.label: Current use
facts.value: Pasture, hay fields and mature hardwood forest; held by one family for more than 70 years

facts.label: Concept program
facts.value: Approximately 300 homesites (townhomes to one-acre estate lots), a possible community marina, trails and open space

facts.label: Shoreline
facts.value: Lake Wheeler is a TVA reservoir; docks and other shoreline structures require TVA Section 26a approval

disclaimer: Sadler Farms represents a potential development opportunity. All plans, layouts, uses and renderings are conceptual and illustrative only, are not engineered, and are subject to planning, engineering, governmental approvals and permitting. Acreage, shoreline length and travel times are approximate and should be independently verified.
